description.description: API Authentication Testing
Broken Object Level Authorization (IDOR via IDs séquentiels et UUIDs)
API Broken Function Level Authorization v2 — admin-class endpoints reachable from lower-privilege or anonymous sessions, plus HTTP method-switching authorization bypass (OWASP API5:2023).
API Excessive Data Exposure v2 — structured JSON response analysis with precise sensitive-key regex, anti-bot/SPA filtering, and pagination-less bulk detection (OWASP API3:2023).

API injection detection v2 — SQLi / NoSQLi / Command / SSTI / LDAPi / XPathi across query, body, header and cookie with error-based, boolean-blind, time-based and OOB oracles (OWASP API8:2023 + API10:2023).
Broken Access Control (forced browsing, priv esc, method bypass)
Account Takeover v2 — password reset poisoning, reset token quality, email change without confirmation, OAuth misconfiguration, account enumeration, MFA bypass.
Détection d'anciennes versions d'API accessibles. v2 avec baseline diff (rejet catch-all), pré-validation anti-bot, et signature API (JSON / OpenAPI markers) obligatoire.
Broken Authentication v2 — rate limiting, default credentials, account lockout, session cookie flags. Uses AttackSurface for login discovery and response_classifier for anti-bot filtering.
Business Logic Flaws (price manipulation, coupon stacking)

Cache deception multi-technique (25+ extensions, 15+ séparateurs, Content-Type mismatch, two-request confirmation authentifiée si auth_recipe disponible, baseline diff via BaselineManager). Pré-validation anti-bot et whitelist des paths publics par design.
Web Cache Poisoning & Cache Deception (unkeyed headers, path confusion)
Clickjacking (iframe, X-Frame-Options, frame-ancestors)
Audit cookies v2 — Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, __Host- / __Secure- prefixes. Whitelists analytics/consent cookies and filters anti-bot responses.
CORS Misconfiguration
CRLF Injection / HTTP Response Splitting (header injection)
CSP Bypass Analysis (unsafe-inline/eval, JSONP, grade A-F)
Cross-Site Request Forgery (tokens, SameSite, Referer)
Insecure Deserialization (Java, PHP, Python, .NET)
Détection de fuites d'information via pages d'erreur — v2 avec pré-validation anti-bot, baseline diff, whitelist endpoints publics, triggers dérivés de l'AttackSurface, catalogue de ~50 patterns.
File Upload Vulns (shell, extension/MIME bypass, SVG XSS)
Directory / File Fuzzing
GraphQL Security (introspection, injection, batching, DoS)
Security Headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options...)
Host Header Injection (reset poisoning, X-Forwarded-Host)
HTTP/2 request smuggling — H2.CL desync, H2.TE desync, CRLF injection in H2 headers, Content-Length mismatch
HTTP Request Smuggling (CL.TE, TE.CL, TE.TE, timing)
Insecure Direct Object Reference
Audit redirection HTTP→HTTPS, HSTS (max-age, includeSubDomains, preload) et leak de cookies sur HTTP. v2 avec pré-validation anti-bot et parsing HSTS structuré.
JWT Attacks (none algo, key confusion, expiry)
Local / Remote File Inclusion
Security Misconfiguration (debug mode, default creds, dir listing)
NoSQL Injection (MongoDB operators, auth bypass, $where blind)
OAuth/OIDC misconfiguration v2 — PKCE, grant types, client registration, id_token signing, client auth, response_mode, client-id enumeration.
Open Redirect
HTTP Parameter Pollution (duplicate params, WAF bypass)
Audit de la politique de mots de passe (longueur, autocomplete, cleartext). v2 avec pré-validation anti-bot et discovery via AttackSurface.
Path traversal detection (facade for web.lfi_rfi v2)
Détection de DOM XSS via window.postMessage — oracle d'exécution actif dans un navigateur headless sur les pages de l'AttackSurface.
Prototype Pollution JS (GET, JSON, client/server-side)
Race Condition / TOCTOU (double-submit, coupon abuse, double-spend)
OS Command Injection detection (error-based, OOB blind, time-based) across all injection locations (query, body, header, cookie).
Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) detection via arithmetic evaluation oracle across all injection locations.
Server-Side Includes (SSI) Injection detection via directive evaluation oracle across all injection locations.
Remote Code Execution (command injection, SSTI)
SAML 2.0 weaknesses v2 — metadata exposure, signature stripping, XML signature wrapping, InResponseTo / Destination absent, assertion replay, XXE via SAMLResponse.
Session Fixation (URL session ID, no rotation, cookie flags, weak entropy)
SQL Injection (blind + error-based)
Server-Side Request Forgery
Test d'accès cross-tenant via manipulation du Host header. v2 avec diff structurel baseline / candidat, pré-validation anti-bot, et confirmation DNS optionnelle.
Web3 / dApp frontend audit v2 — private-key leak, provider key exposure, localStorage anti-pattern, eth_sign, EIP-712 chainId, infinite approve, signature replay.
WebSocket Security (CSWSH, injection, missing auth, cleartext)
Cross-Site Scripting (reflected, stored, DOM-based)
XML External Entity Injection

API GraphQL security audit v2 — strict spec-GraphQL probe, introspection / field suggestion / batching / alias flood / depth DoS / GraphQL-over-GET / unauth-mutation, plus 4-oracle injection (error / boolean / time / OOB) on inline arguments, variables and directives across SQLi, NoSQLi, RCE-cmd, SSTI, LDAPi, XPathi (OWASP API8:2023 + API10:2023).
API gRPC audit v2 — reflection, service enumeration, plaintext (h2c), invalid TLS certificate, unauthenticated method invocation, health-check exposure (OWASP API1 + API5 + API8 + API10).
Mass Assignment (champs non documentes : is_admin, role)
OpenAPI/Swagger Audit (spec exposee, endpoints sans auth)
Rate Limiting (brute force login, register, password reset, OTP)
SSRF detection v2 on API endpoints accepting URL-like parameters — OOB DNS/HTTP, cloud metadata fingerprint, and baseline-diff response-based oracles (OWASP API7:2023, CWE-918).
API versioning exposure v2 — detects legacy API versions that coexist with the current one and that may miss security patches or have weaker authorization checks (OWASP API9:2023, CWE-1059).

API WebSocket audit v2 — missing authentication, CSWSH, cleartext transport, token-in-URL, permissive CORS on upgrade, message-level injection (4 oracles × 6 categories), sensitive-data leak in echoes, GraphQL subscription unauth (OWASP API1 + API2 + API3 + API8 + API10).
Detects CDN/WAF bypass vectors: origin IP leaked in response headers, origin subdomains reachable without the CDN, and proxy-header spoofing that flips backend behaviour.
Detects unauthenticated AWS Cognito Identity Pools, public User Pool sign-up, and exposed Hosted UIs using strict JSON content signatures.
Detects Docker Registry / OCI registries accessible without authentication via anchored JSON signatures on the v2 catalog and tags endpoints.
Detects dangling CNAMEs pointing to deprovisioned cloud resources (AWS S3, Azure App Service, Heroku, GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, Firebase, Shopify, …) that can lead to subdomain takeover.
Detects publicly readable Firebase Realtime Database, Firestore collections, Storage buckets, and unrestricted Identity Toolkit sign-up via anchored JSON signatures.
Cloud IAM Misconfig (policies permissives, credentials exposees)
Detects serverless env-var leakage, stack traces and fingerprint headers on Lambda / Azure Functions / GCP Cloud Functions using anchored signatures and baseline-diff validation.
Cloud Metadata IMDS (AWS IMDSv1/v2, GCP, Azure IMDS)
Cloud Misconfiguration (AWS S3, GCP, Azure)
Audits exposed management services (SSH, RDP, databases, orchestration planes, message brokers, monitoring dashboards) with a protocol-level probe to avoid false positives on generic open ports.
Detects exposed secret stores (HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, Kubernetes Secrets API, GCP Secret Manager, AWS SSM) via strict JSON signatures and response classification.
Detects exposed Terraform state / plan files, unauthenticated Consul KV backends and public HCP Terraform workspaces via anchored JSON signatures and baseline-diff validation.
Audit Consul + etcd — détection unauth access via /v1/agent/self + /version canoniques, KV stores avec sensitive keys regex anchored, ACL tokens listables, auth status etcd.
Default Credentials (SSH, FTP, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB...)
DNS Rebinding (Host validation, CORS permissif, protections manquantes)

Audit Docker Engine API — détection d'exposition sans auth/TLS sur 2375 (HTTP) et 2376 (TLS sans mTLS). Signature canonique via /_ping + /version + confirmation active /containers/json + /info pour escalation CRITICAL.
Audit Elasticsearch / OpenSearch — détection d'accès sans authentification via GET / signature canonique, listage d'indices, bulk _search cross-index, disclosure de version et CVE mapping.
Email Security (SMTP open relay, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, STARTTLS)
FTP Security (anonymous login, bounce attack, banner grabbing, cleartext)
IPMI BMC audit UDP 623 — Get Channel Auth Caps strict, cipher 0 bypass (CRITICAL), RAKP hash disclosure CVE-2013-4786 (HIGH)
IPv6 Security (dual-stack, IPv6-only services, firewall bypass)
Audit Jenkins — détection unauth access via signature X-Jenkins + parsing /api/json (useSecurity flag), confirmation RCE Groovy active, credentials store, users, nodes, environment.
Audit Kerberos v5 — détection KDC, AS-REP Roasting sur comptes courants, chiffrement faible accepté, authentification anonyme.
Audit Kubernetes API — détection API server exposé, kubelet secure/read-only accessible, vérification anonymous-auth via /api/v1/namespaces avec parsing JSON strict.
LDAP Security Audit (anonymous bind, injection, user enum, rootDSE)
Audit Memcached — détection d'accès sans authentification (TCP), disclosure slabs/items, test d'amplification UDP (CVE-2018-1000115).
Audit MongoDB — détection d'accès sans authentification via Wire Protocol OP_QUERY isMaster, listage des bases (listDatabases), disclosure de version et wire version.
Audit MQTT — détection accès anonyme, wildcard subscribe '#' et '$SYS/#', cleartext 1883, credentials par défaut (3.1.1 et 5.0)
Audit Microsoft SQL Server — détection TDS PRELOGIN, politique de chiffrement, disclosure de version, mode d'authentification (Mixed vs Windows), exposition du SQL Server Browser UDP.
Audit NFS — portmapper, versions (NFSv2/v3/v4), énumération des exports via MOUNT, détection d'exports world-readable.
Audit NTP UDP 123 — NTPv4 strict Q1, version disclosure via mode 6 readvar, monlist CVE-2013-5211 avec facteur d'amplification mesuré
Port Scan (nmap + fallback TCP)
Audit Prometheus + Grafana + AlertManager + node_exporter + Pushgateway — détection unauth via signatures JSON/OpenMetrics canoniques, secrets YAML anchored regex, Grafana default creds.
Audit RDP — négociation X.224 pour détecter PROTOCOL_RDP (standard security, sans NLA), parsing spec MS-RDPBCGR strict
Audit Redis — détection d'accès sans authentification via RESP, CONFIG writable (préparation RCE), exposition de données et disclosure de version/OS.
Service Version + CVE Matching
SMB/NetBIOS Enumeration
SNMP Community String Bruteforce
Audit SSH (ssh-audit wrapper) — algorithmes obsolètes, CVEs, version disclosure
SSL/TLS Audit (ciphers, certs, BEAST/POODLE/Heartbleed)
Audit Telnet — port 23 cleartext, device fingerprint, default credentials
Audit VNC — validation banner RFB anchored, confirmation active de SecurityType None via ServerInit, test de passwords triviaux pour VNC Auth
Audit WinRM (WS-Management) — détection stricte, cleartext HTTP, Basic auth sur HTTP, accès non authentifié via SOAP Enumerate
ASN / WHOIS Lookup
Détection de fichiers sensibles exposés : backup, config, debug, IDE
Détection cloud provider (AWS/GCP/Azure/Cloudflare/…) via headers + DNS — alimente SharedContext pour les modules cloud/* (INFO only)
DNS Zone Transfer
Récolte d'emails OSINT (mailto + scan HTML) avec classification anti-FP — toutes les findings en INFO

Identification de technologies par hash MurmurHash3 du favicon (Shodan-compatible). Détecte Grafana, Jenkins, GitLab, Fortinet, Prometheus, Kubernetes Dashboard, etc. N'émet qu'un finding INFO — la présence d'un favicon ne prouve pas l'exposition publique non protégée du service (certains dashboards sont publics par design).
Technology Fingerprinting
Détection de répertoires VCS exposés (.git, .svn, .hg, .bzr)
Découverte d'organisations GitHub/GitLab, repos publics, emails de développeurs — oracles stricts (regex ancrées, API JSON validée)

Détection des méthodes HTTP dangereuses (TRACE, TRACK, DEBUG, PUT, DELETE, CONNECT, PATCH) avec baseline diff pour filtrer les catch-all SPA, whitelist des contextes REST, et confirmation stricte du TRACE via écho d'un header canary.
Analyse JS : extraction d'endpoints, secrets (patterns ancrés), commentaires
Port Scan Light (top ports rapide)
Cartographie passive : robots.txt, sitemap.xml, .well-known/security.txt
Énumération de buckets cloud storage (AWS S3, DigitalOcean Spaces, GCS) par permutations du domaine — oracle XML strict
Screenshot de la cible
Détection de source maps JS exposées (code source, secrets)
Subdomain Enumeration
Subdomain Takeover (CNAME dangling vers services cloud)

Fingerprinting approfondi : cookies de session, chemins d'assets JS, data-attributes HTML, headers spécifiques aux frameworks modernes. Complémentaire de ``recon.fingerprint`` (qui lit les signatures explicites type ``Server`` et ``X-Powered-By``).
WAF Detection

Analyse statique C#/.NET via tree-sitter AST : SqlCommand concat, BinaryFormatter, NetDataContractSerializer, LosFormatter, Html.Raw, Response.Write, MD5/SHA1/DES/RC2, Process.Start, DirectorySearcher, Random, ViewState MAC, secrets hardcodes.
SCA — dependances vulnerables (CVE via OSV.dev)
Docker Security (USER root, secrets in layers, :latest)

Analyse statique Go via tree-sitter AST : imports crypto faible (md5/sha1/des/rc4/math-rand), SQL via fmt.Sprintf, exec.Command avec variable/shell, InsecureSkipVerify, SSLv3, unsafe.Pointer, secrets hardcodes.
IaC Security (Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes)

Analyse statique Java via tree-sitter AST : Runtime.getRuntime, ObjectInputStream, XMLDecoder, XStream, JNDI lookup, XXE parsers, crypto faible (DES/ECB/MD5/SHA1), Random, Spring CSRF disable, path traversal, secrets hardcodes.
Analyse Statique JS/TS (eval, DOM XSS, secrets, ReDoS)
License audit v2 : classification SPDX (permissive/weak/strong/network copyleft/proprietary), expressions composees, detection conflits projet vs dep, transitives node_modules

Analyse statique PHP via tree-sitter AST : SQLi (mysql_query / PDO / wpdb), command injection (system/shell_exec/backticks), code injection (eval/assert/preg_replace e/create_function), unserialize user input, LFI/RFI (include/require), XSS (echo superglobale), path traversal, SSRF (curl), crypto faible, mcrypt, extract, secrets hardcodes.
Analyse Statique Python (secrets, vulns, deps)

Analyse statique Ruby/Rails via tree-sitter AST : SQLi (where/find_by_sql/execute interp), command injection (system/exec/backtick interp), eval/instance_eval/class_eval sur params, send(params), YAML/Marshal.load, permit! mass assignment, html_safe / ERB raw, redirect_to params, Digest::MD5/SHA1, secrets hardcodes.

SBOM v2 : genere un Software Bill of Materials au format CycloneDX 1.5 JSON a partir des manifests/lockfiles de tous les ecosystemes supportes (PyPI/npm/RubyGems/Go/Cargo/Packagist/Maven/NuGet). 1 seul finding INFO de synthese par scan, SBOM complet en evidence.
Secrets multi-langage (AWS, GCP, Azure, Stripe, GitHub)

Supply chain v2 : typosquatting (Damerau-Levenshtein), scripts preinstall/postinstall suspects (pipe-to-shell, base64 decode, reverse shell), dependency confusion, lockfiles manquants, versions non pinnees, replace local go.mod, dep via URL/git/file://
